title: ModawemDrugAllergenRelationshipRecord
description: Schema definition for Modawem drug-allergen cross-reference dataset records.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific allergen relationship record.

allergen_name.description: Name of the allergen, drug, or substance provoking hypersensitivity.

allergen_class.description: Clinical or chemical drug class of the allergen (e.g., Penicillins, Sulfonamides).

ingredient_name.description: Standardized active pharmaceutical ingredient evaluated for relationship/reactivity.

ingredient_id.description: Unique identifier for the ingredient in the given coding system (e.g., RxNorm RxCUI).

ingredient_id_system.description: Coding authority for ingredient identifier (e.g., RxNorm, UNII, CAS, custom).

relationship_type.description: Strict clinical relationship between the allergen/class and target ingredient.

evidence_summary.description: Summary of pharmacological evidence, immunological studies, or official prescribing warnings.

qualifiers.description: Structural, immunological, or clinical qualifiers (e.g., R1 side-chain similarity, non-arylamine sulfonamide, IgE-mediated).

source_id.description: Identifier of the originating source institution or dataset.

source_record_id.description: Identifier of the record within the originating source.

source_version.description: Version, release tag, or publication date of the source.

source_url.description: Direct canonical link to the source material.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp recording retrieval date.

notes.description: Clinical nuances, exclusions, or review flags.
